Strategy: I treated each action phase as a rock-paper-scissors stage game with payoffs set by the two revealed numbers, playing only actions in the equilibrium support (Hold/Trap when my number was much bigger, Hold/Steal when much smaller, anything when close) and adjusting for card inventories, which is how I led 20-2 after three rounds; I front-loaded my big numbers while I still held Traps, used my last Trap in round 5 on the 6-vs-10 round (which Blue answered with Hold), and then with no Traps left I was structurally down for the final four rounds, where I worked out the small endgame trees by hand and kept the loss to the coin-flip minimum (expected -6.5 over the last two forced rounds, realised -6).
